ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_watermark interrupt (status type, default 1): raised if the transmit FIFO is past the high-water mark.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_watermark interrupt behavior with a clear trigger condition: raised when transmit FIFO past its high-water mark.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_watermark interrupt (status type): raised if the receive FIFO is past the high-water mark.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_watermark interrupt behavior with a clear trigger condition: raised when receive FIFO past high-water mark.

ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_done interrupt: raised if the transmit FIFO has emptied and no transmit is ongoing.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_done interrupt behavior: raised when transmit FIFO empty and no ongoing transmission.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_overflow interrupt: raised if the receive FIFO has overflowed.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_overflow interrupt behavior: raised on receive FIFO overflow.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_frame_err interrupt: raised if a framing error has been detected on receive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_frame_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected receive framing error.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_break_err interrupt: raised if break condition has been detected on receive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_break_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected break condition during receive.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_timeout interrupt: raised if RX FIFO has characters remaining in the FIFO without being retrieved for the programmed time period.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_timeout interrupt behavior: raised when RX FIFO has data not retrieved within programmed timeout.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_parity_err interrupt: raised if the receiver has detected a parity error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_parity_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected receiver parity error.

ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_empty interrupt (status type, default 1): raised if the transmit FIFO is empty.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_empty interrupt behavior: raised when transmit FIFO is empty.

ref_atoms.ref_content: fatal_fault alert: triggered when a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault is detected.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies fatal_fault alert trigger condition: detection of a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.PARITY: The UART can be configured so that it sends (or expects) a parity bit after each 8 data bits. In receive mode, the UART sends the rx_parity_err interrupt if it receives a parity bit of the wrong polarity. The parity mode is configurable (ensuring words are even or odd).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes configurable parity generation/checking and rx_parity_err interrupt on wrong polarity, providing concrete hardware behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.LINE_LOOPBACK: The UART can be configured so that incoming bits are sent on the TX side.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies line loopback behavior: incoming bits forwarded to TX, a concrete hardware path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.SYSTEM_LOOPBACK: The UART can be configured so that outgoing bits are registered as having been received on the RX side.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies system loopback behavior: outgoing bits treated as received on RX, a concrete hardware loopback path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.BAUD_RATE_CONTROL: The UART baud rate can be configured.

Feature UART.LINE_BREAK: The UART can detect line breaks (defined as the RX pin being continuously low for several bit-times). The threshold for number of low bits to signal a line break is configurable.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines line break detection (RX pin low for several bit-times) with configurable low-bit threshold, a concrete hardware detection mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.FIFO_INTERRUPTS: The UART can be configured to send a 'watermark' interrupt when RX or TX FIFO is nearly full/empty, respectively. It sends an rx_overflow interrupt if it sees an extra character when the RX FIFO is full.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes watermark interrupts for RX/TX FIFO nearly full/empty and rx_overflow on full RX FIFO, providing concrete interrupt generation conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: lsio_trigger signal (uni, req): Self-clearing status trigger for the DMA. Set when RX or TX FIFOs are past their configured watermarks matching watermark interrupt behaviour.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines lsio_trigger as a self-clearing DMA trigger set when FIFOs pass watermarks, matching watermark interrupt behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: racl_policies signal (uni, rcv): Incoming RACL policy vector from a racl_ctrl instance. The policy selection vector (parameter) selects the policy for each register.
racl_error signal (uni, req, width 1): RACL error log information of this module.
BUS.INTEGRITY countermeasure: End-to-end bus integrity scheme.

Register CTRL [rw]: Controls UART operation. Fields: TX (bit0 TX enable), RX (bit1 RX enable), NF (bit2 RX noise filter enable: if enabled, RX line goes through 3-tap repetition code, ignores single IP clock period noise), SLPBK (bit4 System loopback enable: if on, outgoing bits to TX are received through RX; TX line goes 1), LLPBK (bit5 Line loopback enable: if on, incoming bits are forwarded to TX; internal design sees RX value as 1 always), PARITY_EN (bit6 enable parity in both RX and TX), PARITY_ODD (bit7 parity type: 1 odd, 0 even, when PARITY_EN is true), RXBLVL (bits9:8 trigger level for RX break detection: sets number of character times line must be low to detect a break, values 0=2, 1=4, 2=8, 3=16 characters), NCO (bits31:16 BAUD clock rate control).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: CTRL register defines multiple control functions with explicit bit fields and concrete hardware behaviors (noise filter, loopback modes, parity, break detection levels, baud rate).

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register STATUS [ro]: UART live status. Fields: TXFULL (bit0 TX buffer is full), RXFULL (bit1 RX buffer is full), TXEMPTY (bit2 TX FIFO is empty, reset 1), TXIDLE (bit3 TX FIFO empty and all bits transmitted, reset 1), RXIDLE (bit4 RX is idle, reset 1), RXEMPTY (bit5 RX FIFO is empty, reset 1).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: STATUS register provides real-time FIFO and activity status indicators (full, empty, idle) with defined hardware semantics and reset values.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register FIFO_CTRL [rw]: UART FIFO control. Fields: RXRST (bit0 write 1 resets RX FIFO, read returns 0), TXRST (bit1 write 1 resets TX FIFO, read returns 0), RXILVL (bits4:2 trigger level for RX interrupts: if FIFO depth >= setting, raises rx_watermark; values 0=1,1=2,2=4,3=8,4=16,5=32,6=62 characters), TXILVL (bits7:5 trigger level for TX interrupts: if FIFO depth < setting, raises tx_watermark; values 0=1,1=2,2=4,3=8,4=16 characters).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: FIFO_CTRL register controls FIFO reset (write-1-to-reset) and programmable interrupt watermarks with explicit trigger rules for RX and TX FIFOs.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register OVRD [rw]: TX pin override control. Fields: TXEN (bit0 enable TX pin override control), TXVAL (bit1 write to set the value of the TX pin).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: OVRD register provides a TX pin override mechanism with enable and direct value control, a concrete hardware override function.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register TIMEOUT_CTRL [rw]: UART RX timeout control. Fields: VAL (bits23:0 RX timeout value in UART bit times), EN (bit31 enable RX timeout feature).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: TIMEOUT_CTRL register enables RX timeout and sets the timeout value in bit times, defining a concrete hardware timeout mechanism.
